title.narrative: YR1 OF 5 PYMNT OF THE PROJECT CUSP PROGRAMME: CU - SUSTAINABLE

description.narrative: The overall aim of the project is to grow the Credit Union movement through focusing on three interlocking goals which are critical to the sustainability of the movement.Safe and Sound CU's - Following a risk based monitoring approach and continued engagement with the Central Bank, The Ministry of Trade and Industry and the Department of Cooperation to embed an appropriate regulatory environment supporting Risk-Based Supervision of CUsGrowth - Reaching greater numbers of Sierra Leoneans through growth pathwaysSustainability - Ensuring CU's are making a surplus and are willing to fund NaCCUA and its planned services, including advocacy, capacity building, monitoring, supervision, CU audits technology.
